details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:29-57 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `render_prompt.sh` no longer substitutes `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`, so judge prompts render the literal placeholder instead of injected Semble context.
  WHY: `prompts/mode-judge.txt:3`, `prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt:3`, and `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:3` still contain the placeholder and callers still export `SEMBLE_PREFETCH`, so the prepared context is silently dropped.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:392-440 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Successful overflow-path Semble queries no longer emit `SEMBLE_QUERY` telemetry.
  WHY: Only the fallback path still logs telemetry, so `scripts/cost_audit.py` will undercount overflow-target Semble queries and their bytes.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-128,223-230 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Cached issue metadata is accepted on a non-empty-file check without verifying that `.number` matches the current issue.
  WHY: Stale `ISSUE_META_FILE` data from a reused workspace can feed the wrong labels and body into the diagnose prompt; reviewers rated this from medium up to critical, but the highest severity is critical.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-444 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose-phase Semble query/prefetch block was removed from prompt assembly.
  WHY: The diagnose prompt no longer includes any Semble-prefetched repository context, reducing groundedness and diagnosis accuracy; reviewers ranged from high to medium, so the highest severity is high.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:135-136,303-313,374-386 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_normalize_semble_max_chunks()` and its cap were removed, so `semble_max_chunks` is no longer bounded.
  WHY: Values like `0` can now reach the Semble CLI as `--top-k 0` and large values can bypass the old cap, degrading context quality; reviewers split between medium and low, so the highest severity is medium.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:425-440 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Python fallback logs now use a simplified print format instead of the richer `_log_semble_event` telemetry.
  WHY: The fallback output loses fields such as `ms`/chunk detail and is inconsistent with shell helpers, reducing audit granularity; reviewers called this medium or low, so the highest severity is medium.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:34-36 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The trailing-whitespace trim was removed from placeholder matching.
  WHY: A line like `{{WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION}}   ` no longer matches the placeholder case, so unresolved placeholders can now trigger a render failure.
- docs/semble-integration-plan.md:452-459,487,749-769 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan still describes `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` handling and `render_prompt.sh` substitution that were removed.
  WHY: The document now describes functionality that no longer exists, which will mislead maintainers about Semble context injection.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:79 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `_extract_log_field` stops at whitespace, so field values containing spaces are truncated.
  WHY: Space-containing `reason=` payloads in `SEMBLE_FALLBACK`/`SEMBLE_QUERY` lines will be parsed incompletely, which can corrupt audit details.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:29-50 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR removed the `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` placeholder substitution and unresolved-placeholder guard from `render_prompt.sh`.
  WHY: `prompts/mode-judge.txt:3`, `prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt:3`, `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:3`, and callers `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:328`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5705`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9417`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10794` still rely on it, so judge prompts keep the literal placeholder instead of Semble context.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:425-434 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The overflow-path `SEMBLE_QUERY` telemetry emission was removed from `emit_context`.
  WHY: When Semble succeeds, the code now updates `overflow_rendered_bytes` silently; `cost_audit.py` loses the overflow-target query/byte telemetry and can only see fallback logs.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:125-126 and 226-227 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `issue_meta_matches_issue` was removed, so cached `ISSUE_META_FILE` contents are accepted without checking that the JSON `.number` matches `${ISSUE_NUMBER}`.
  WHY: On a reused workspace, stale metadata from a different issue can feed incorrect labels and body into the diagnose prompt.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-379 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The diagnose-phase Semble query builder and final Semble query block were removed from prompt assembly.
  WHY: The diagnose prompt no longer includes any Semble-prefetched context block, reducing groundedness for post-Codex failure diagnosis.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:135-136 and 374-386 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_normalize_semble_max_chunks()` was removed, so `semble_max_chunks` is no longer clamped.
  WHY: `--top-k 0` can now reach Semble and return zero results, and very large values are no longer capped.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:34 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The trailing-whitespace trim before placeholder matching was removed.
  WHY: A line like `{{WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION}}   ` will no longer match the placeholder case and will pass through unresolved.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:29-47 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `render_prompt.sh` no longer resolves `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}`.
  WHY: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5705`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9198`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10783`, and `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:328` still set `SEMBLE_PREFETCH`, while the judge prompt files still contain `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}:3`, so the rendered prompt contains literal garbage text instead of the Semble context block.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:392-440 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Successful overflow Semble queries no longer emit `SEMBLE_QUERY` telemetry.
  WHY: `scripts/cost_audit.py` can no longer measure successful overflow queries or their bytes, so audit tooling systematically undercounts Semble usage.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-128, 223-227 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Cached issue metadata validation was weakened from a `.number` match check to a simple non-empty-file check.
  WHY: Stale cached metadata from a previous issue in a reused workspace can be used for the wrong issue and feed incorrect labels/body into the diagnose prompt.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-444 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The diagnose-phase Semble query builder and prefetch block were removed from prompt generation.
  WHY: The diagnose prompt loses targeted repository context from Semble, reducing the accuracy of post-failure diagnosis.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:374-386 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_normalize_semble_max_chunks()` was removed, so invalid values can now reach the Semble CLI.
  WHY: A `--semble-max-chunks` value of `0` or an excessively large number can now be passed through instead of being clamped.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:436 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback log format is now simpler and less informative.
  WHY: The Python fallback print omits richer fields such as timing/chunk detail, making audit analysis less granular.
- docs/semble-integration-plan.md:487, 749-759 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The plan document still references `{{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}` placeholder handling that was removed.
  WHY: The documentation now describes old behavior that no longer exists.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:79 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_extract_log_field` uses `([^\s]+)`, which stops at the first whitespace.
  WHY: Values like `reason=exit=9 stderr tail with spaces` get truncated to `exit=9`, so space-containing fields are parsed incorrectly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The fallback logging format uses a simple print statement with fewer fields than the old helper.
